changelog: - **Follow-ups from the review of mentee-owned projects** (#2270). Four holes the shipped change left behind. (1) The project-level IP gate is now withheld from a MENTEE server-side, symmetrically with `isPublic`: `POST /api/projects` ignores `contributorTermsRequired` / `contributorTermsKey` from a mentee creator, and `PUT /api/projects/[id]` refuses either field (plus `isPublic`) from a mentee owner with 403 `programme_only`. Only the portal form hid the picker before, so a hand-rolled `{"contributorTermsRequired": false}` created a project nobody joining it was ever asked to accept terms for — and one that dropped out of the admin acceptance report, which counts `contributorTermsRequired: true` rows only. (2) `canManageMembers()` in `[id]/members` now honours the legacy `ownerUserId` pointer, like `isProjectOwner()` and like the `isLead` test on `/projects/[id]`: it read OWNER `ProjectMember` rows only, so on every topic/preview environment (the demo seeder sets `ownerUserId` alone and no deploy script runs `backfill-project-members.mjs`) the demo owner got the members panel rendered and a 403 from every fetch behind it — a silently empty roster. (3) `ProjectForm` is keyed on the edit target in `ProjectsManager`, so switching pencils with the form open no longer saves project A's values (owner included) onto project B — the extracted form seeds its state once, where the old inline form re-populated it in `edit()`. (4) The advice given to a mentee owner is now true: a private project cannot receive join requests (`not_public`), and only an admin can publish a mentee-created one, so the members panel says so for a private project (new `projects.ownerInviteAskAdmin`, EN/TR/DE), the `mentee_owner_invite` 403 names that step, and the `menteeOwnProject` feature-catalogue copy no longer promises a join-request flow that cannot occur while the project is private. No schema change.

en: A project's contributor-terms setting is now the programme's decision on the server too, not just in the form — a mentee-created project always keeps the platform default.
A project owner whose membership row predates the member list is no longer locked out of their own roster.
Editing one project and then clicking the pencil on another no longer carries the first project's values over.
tr: Bir projenin katkı sözleşmesi ayarı artık yalnızca formda değil sunucuda da programın kararı — mentee'nin açtığı proje her zaman platform varsayılanını korur.
Üye listesinden eski olan sahiplik kaydına sahip proje sahipleri artık kendi ekip listesinden dışlanmıyor.
Bir projeyi düzenlerken başka bir projenin kalemine basmak artık ilk projenin değerlerini taşımıyor.
de: Die Contributor-Terms-Einstellung eines Projekts entscheidet das Programm jetzt auch serverseitig, nicht nur im Formular — ein von einem Mentee angelegtes Projekt behält immer die Plattform-Vorgabe.
Projekt-Eigentümer, deren Eigentum nur über den alten Zeiger hinterlegt ist, werden nicht mehr aus ihrer eigenen Mitgliederliste ausgesperrt.
Wer ein Projekt bearbeitet und dann auf den Stift eines anderen klickt, überträgt nicht mehr die Werte des ersten Projekts.
